task.title: Add kanban-quick command for fast implementation workflow
task.description: A new /kanban-quick command that provides a streamlined path for small fixes, config changes, and simple features. Combines task creation, scoping, planning, and implementation into a single skill with minimal Q&A.
task.problem: The current kanban workflow (create, scope, plan, implement, check, docs, PR) is thorough but too heavyweight for small fixes, config changes, or simple features. Developers need a faster path that preserves key benefits (atomic commits, branching, traceability) without the full ceremony of multiple sequential skills.
task.value: Faster implementation for straightforward tasks while maintaining git workflow hygiene (branching, atomic commits) and traceability via quick.xml artifact. Optional doc updates and commit review based on user preference. One skill instead of multiple sequential skills.
task.acceptance-criteria:
Given the user runs /kanban-quick with a task description When the Q&A phase begins Then the LLM asks "What problem are you solving?" And the LLM asks "What does done look like?" And no "value" question is asked (kept minimal)
Given Q&A is complete When implementation begins Then a branch named quick/{id} is created And a file .kanban/quick/{id}/quick.xml is created And the quick.xml contains combined task+spec+plan info (simpler than 3 separate files)
Given implementation is complete When the LLM is ready to commit Then the LLM asks "Do you want to review changes before I commit?" And if user says yes, the diff is shown and approval requested And if user says no, the commit proceeds immediately
Given the commit is complete When the LLM prompts for docs Then the LLM asks "Do you want me to update docs?" And if user says yes, product/engineering docs are updated And if user says no, docs are skipped
Given the workflow completes Then a new quick.xml template exists at .kanban/templates/quick.xml And the skill file exists at .claude/skills/kanban-quick/kanban-quick.skill.md
